class: Standing consent reversal: always accept acknowledgements, terms, background checks, certifications, and marketing opt-ins
symptom: Account creation and application runs repeatedly paused or stopped for human handoff on boilerplate terms, background check consents, certifications, communication preferences, and marketing opt-ins. Furthermore, f276 previously mandated unticking pre-ticked marketing boxes like Walmart's 'new arrivals' box.
site: Cross-portal (Walmart, Workday, Dayforce, ADP, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby)
root_cause: f276 treated marketing opt-ins as 'never the agent's to give' and actively unticked them, while page_agent and browser_automation gated terms, background check consents, certifications, and communications behind profile flags (sign_attestations, accept_application_privacy_prompts).
why_tests_missed: Tests specifically encoded the old conservative gating and f276 unticking behavior instead of the autonomous application objective.
fix: Reversed the f276 rule and conservative checkbox gating (Task 3). Created reference/acknowledgements.json and acknowledgements.py covering terms, privacy, data processing, certifications, background checks, e-signatures, at-will, arbitration, SMS/email communications, and marketing opt-ins. All matching checkboxes and buttons are automatically ticked or pressed; pre-ticked boxes (e.g. Walmart marketing) stay ticked. Checkboxes that represent legal answers (such as US work authorization or visa sponsorship) remain classified as legal questions under Task 1 and are never ticked blindly.
prevention: Decouple legal declaration questions from standard procedural acknowledgements and consent agreements so autonomous submission proceeds reliably without unnecessary manual handoffs.
